Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs due to the incorrect use of Class#isInstance(Object) with a Class object as the parameter instead of an instance of an object. The method isInstance is intended to check if an object is an instance of a class, not if a class is an instance of another class. The correct method to use for checking class compatibility is isAssignableFrom.
